facts.fact: The guidelines say the New Deal Technologique, a new national digital strategy placing digital technology and AI at the heart of the country's economic and social transformation, was launched ('lancement') in February 2025; they name no adopting act or body.

note: Passages only; the passage is cut off before naming the country it describes, but the strategy is Senegal's by name. Class national on the description (economic and social transformation).
